messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A stout quadrupedal creature with a pale gray broad-snouted amphibian head, large round eyes, and clusters of pink feathery external gills on the sides of the neck, a low thick body with a pale wrinkled underside, four short thick clawed legs, and a back and long tapering tail completely covered in overlapping dark brown pangolin-like scales.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat pale gray salamander head with rounded snout and dark speckled skin", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body, facing to the right"}, {"looks_like": "large round dark eyes with pale blue-gray rims", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "pink stalked feathery external gills with fine filaments", "part": "gills", "where": "in clusters on the left and right sides of the head and neck, four visible on the near side and three on the far side"}, {"looks_like": "stout low body with pale wrinkled amphibian skin on the underside", "part": "torso", "where": "between the head and tail, under the scaled back"}, {"looks_like": "short thick pale gray amphibian legs with wrinkled skin", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two front and two rear"}, {"looks_like": "broad five-toed feet with small dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "large overlapping brown-gray keeled pangolin-like scales", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the entire back from behind the head over the body"}, {"looks_like": "long tapering scaled tail", "part": "tail", "where": "extending behind the body to the left"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
